notes.title: While you wait: Check out my other game!
notes.content:
Hey, y'all!

I've been cranking away on my projects, with Cloud Miners still being worked on over time, and I recently released Shell Out Showdown into Early Access on Steam! You can check it out here:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1556660/Shell_Out_Showdown/

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36997410/7e64857f52e98bc6770cdb584efe08e4305c650e.gif[/img]

I've had a blast making this game and playing it with friends, streamers, and other gamers. I think you'll have fun with it too, so check it out!

If you want to stay up to date on all my projects, check out my social media and Twitch stream:

https://twitter.com/manadream_

https://www.instagram.com/manadream.exe

https://www.twitch.tv/manadream_
